content:
CR78-pattern is a sequence generator. Select one of 21 preset drum pattern. The module generates the midi notes.

Version History:
1.0 – Initial Release. Oct 20 2022
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

INSTALLATION ON ORGANELLE
- move downloaded CR78-pattern.zop into $USER_DIR/Patches ($USER_DIR can be /sdcard or /usbdrive)
- install on Organelle, CR78-pattern folder will be automatically moved to $USER_DIR/media/orac/usermodules/sequence

WHAT IS THIS MODULE?
This module generates midi notes based on the selected drum pattern. The drum pattern are derived from the original Roland CR-78 drum machine. You can add a predefined tambourine and guiro sequence. There is also the possibility to mute kick, cymbals and snare, respectively.
All generated midi note values can be adjusted to provide maximum compatibility with other synth modules.
It is based on the fantastic ComputerRhythm78 patch (https://patchstorage.com/computerrhythm/).

HOW DO I USE THIS MODULE?
Use this module before a synth module in the chain. You could e.g. set CR78-pattern in slot A1 and then the RealSampler24 module (https://patchstorage.com/realsampler24/) in A2 to have the CR78 pattern be played on the sampler. The sound then depends on the selected kit in the sampler.
Then, simply press AUX in the CR78-pattern module to start the beat. 
You can still play live notes on the keyboard.

A typical use case would be:
1. CR78-pattern in A1 slot
2. RealSampler24 in A2 slot
3. CR78-Kit (copy wav files from original ComputerRhythm78 patch to $USER_DIR/media/samples/kit-x) in RealSampler24


+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
